name: phantom-media
description: The standalone monorepo for Phantom Downloader and Phantom Stream.

scripts.check: turbo run typecheck lint test build
scripts.deployment:check: pnpm run deployment:check:downloader && pnpm run deployment:check:stream
scripts.deployment:check:stream: pnpm --filter @phantom/stream exec opennextjs-cloudflare build && pnpm --filter @phantom/stream exec wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.release:check: pnpm check && pnpm deployment:check && pnpm container:build:downloader
